planets.name: TOI-5205 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5205 with a 1.63-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-5205 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5205. Its orbit and size follow Kanodia et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
